notes.title: SlimeTime Playtest Over!
notes.notes:
Regardless of our position in life, one thing that remains a constant is time.

There is never enough time....

I unfortunately have not found enough time to make this project into what I had envisioned (at least in it's current form). The Playtest has ended (removed from the store and will be removed completely at a later date).

Thank you to everyone that took the time to download it and play (even for a few minutes).

While I've had fun developing and learning when creating these projects, I have forgotten the main goal
is to make a fun and unique experience for the player/s.

I will be going back to basics for the initial release of SlimeTime. No soccer, just slime.

SlimeTime MVP begins re-development today.

Let's do this

notes.title: SlimeTime PlayTest v0.48 - Replication Update
notes.notes:
[i]So - we are back at it. This is the first in many soon to be uploaded patches; on our way to release (Currently April 1st).[/i]

[b]CLIENT REPLICATION[/b]
We have been working on resolving the replication issues that were plaguing the past few releases. This is mainly affecting the Character Movement component in UE4. Utilizing a plugin, the synch issues have been resolved - obviously latency will still be a factor, if ping exceeds 500 - the experience will be compromised (but that is true of any game). Playtesting will continue during this update. Once we are confident these issues are under control - more users will be added for the next large patch (0.49).

[b]GAMEMODES/LEVELS[/b]
A New Gamemode, Player Controller and Pawn were implemented for 'Cummies'. Replacing the MakeHuman character is our in-house default character. This is due to an ongoing effort to use as much self created content as possible.  SlimeTime is a project that we are all learning from and it will improve as we do. No new levels with this update - maybe next time :P

[b]ADDITIONS/CHANGES[/b]
The Green Gobbler has been brought to life with a few new custom animations (Idle and Attack) more will be added in the future as we refine our character models. In addition to some cosmetic changes the SlimeMachine has a new ability; Teleport. The existing 'Slime' ability has been changed to a timer based refresh - [i]no more bukkake blasting.[/i]
As mentioned above, the main character has been replaced with 'Blue Boy'. The Stamina system has been revised. GreenGummer has infinite while 'Blue Boy' has a Stamina bar. Stamina Pickups can be found scattered around the maps.

[b]REMOVALS[/b]
A handful of features have been removed; some temporarily some are more likely permanent. This includes but is not limited to...
-First Person view
-Chat

Our next update will be a major one. Stay tuned - [u][b]come join our discord [/b][/u]- AND if you want to play a few rounds - just ask!!

Slime on!

-gb

notes.title: SlimeTime PlayTest v0.47 - More bug fixes
notes.notes:
A couple more fixes have been implemented... 

[b]CLIENT REPLICATION[/b]
Replication for the Client is still not perfect, but is better. We will be doing more testing with our new Player Controller/Pawn for a possible v0.5 roll-out. 

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
I've shortened the length of the line trace for vaulting from 500 to 400, seems to work much nicer on 'The Facilities', animation is still far from perfect. Our new PC will have a short and long vaults, currently it doesn't check for the depth of an object. 

[b]MOUSE-LOOK, LOCKED[/b]
Lastly but most importantly, I've tracked down the cause of PC mouse disconnection (at least I hope). When a second round began; if a player pressed 'T' for chat, the window would not appear and the mouse-look would be locked. I've tackled that issue; but a smaller, non game-breaker has surfaced. You have to press 'T' twice after round two and if the other user hasn't done the same - they wont auto-receive messages. I think It's not storing the state it was last in on reset. 

Will hopefully get this and the Pause Menu Volume sliders issues resolved for v0.5

Slime on you sex machines!

-ib
